title: Volcano with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- sky glow clouds -->
  <ellipse cx="20" cy="25" rx="14" ry="7" fill="#5B4B8A"/>
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="22" rx="12" ry="6" fill="#5B4B8A"/>
  <!-- volcano mountain body -->
  <polygon points="50,25 18,85 82,85" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <!-- lighter face area of mountain -->
  <polygon points="50,35 25,82 75,82" fill="#A0714F"/>
  <!-- crater top -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="27" rx="16" ry="6" fill="#6B3A1E"/>
  <!-- lava in crater -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="27" rx="12" ry="4" fill="#FF7A00"/>
  <!-- lava glow in crater -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="27" rx="7" ry="2.5" fill="#FFD24A"/>
  <!-- lava flow left -->
  <path d="M42,28 Q36,40 30,52 Q28,58 32,60 Q36,58 38,50 Q42,40 46,30 Z" fill="#FF7A00"/>
  <!-- lava flow right -->
  <path d="M58,28 Q64,42 72,55 Q74,60 70,62 Q66,58 62,48 Q58,38 54,30 Z" fill="#FF7A00"/>
  <!-- lava flow highlight left -->
  <path d="M44,30 Q39,40 34,50 Q33,54 35,55 Q38,52 40,46 Q43,38 46,31 Z" fill="#FFD24A"/>
  <!-- lava flow highlight right -->
  <path d="M56,30 Q61,42 67,52 Q68,56 66,57 Q63,54 60,46 Q56,38 54,31 Z" fill="#FFD24A"/>
  <!-- small lava drips -->
  <circle cx="27" cy="56" r="2.5" fill="#FF7A00"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="58" r="2.5" fill="#FF7A00"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="55" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#2E1A0E"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="55" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#2E1A0E"/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="53" r="2" fill="#FFD24A"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="53" r="2" fill="#FFD24A"/>
  <!-- eye highlight small -->
  <circle cx="38.5" cy="57" r="1" fill="#FF7A00"/>
  <circle cx="58.5" cy="57" r="1" fill="#FF7A00"/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d="M40,66 Q50,76 60,66" stroke="#2E1A0E" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx="32" cy="63" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#FF7A00" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="68" cy="63" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#FF7A00" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- tiny nose -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="2.5" ry="1.8" fill="#6B3A1E"/>
  <!-- ground -->
  <rect x="8" y="85" width="84" height="8" fill="#4A7A3A" rx="3"/>
</svg>
